Subject: Next steps and trial scoring plan — ChiTel contact center POC

Hi Aisha / Liam — thanks again for a productive call today. Quick recap and an actionable plan for the trial so we can align on scope, success criteria, timing, and ownership. Please review and confirm or flag any items you want adjusted.

Recap (brief)
- Goal: deploy a 4-week trial that demonstrates call-center summarization + agent assist for English & Spanish channels; measure reduction in wrap time and auto-suggest usefulness.
- Primary personas: contact center supervisors (quality), L2 agents (assists), platform engineers (integration).

Recommended trial design
- Model selection for trial: Mistral-Instruct-7B-v1 as the primary open model (fast, cost-efficient), fallback: Llama-2-13B-chat (q4_0 quant) if higher-context or domain-hallucination scenarios need greater capacity.
- Multilingual approach: run primary evals in EN and ES. Prompt templates included in attachment (trial_test_prompts.jsonl). For ES fidelity, use the Llama-2-13B-chat fallback on Spanish-heavy dialogs in week 2 if quality thresholds aren't met.

Success criteria (PASS/FAIL style) — see attached success matrix
- Summaries: ROUGE-L >= 0.6 vs human QA sample (weekly sampling).
- Agent assist CTR: suggested completion used in >= 25% of eligible interactions.
- Latency: 95th percentile generation latency < 800ms for single-turn assists (hosted mode target).
- Regression: no increase in critical hallucinations above baseline (>2% flagged items triggers rollback).

Evaluation plan & timelines
- Week 0 (this week): finalize SSO/credentials, dataset access, and shared test prompts. (Owners: ChiTel: Aisha / Liam, Redwood: Diego + Priya)
- Week 1: smoke tests, baseline collection, initial EN-only runs. (Owners: Redwood eng + ChiTel infra)
- Week 2: full EN+ES runs, switch in fallback model for Spanish A/B where applicable.
- Week 3: focused quality evals, human review sampling, and latency/cost tuning.
- Week 4: wrap, results deck, recommendation for production path.

Ownership & roles
- Redwood PM (trial ops): Diego Fernandez — single point of contact.
- Redwood eng lead (integration/benching): Priya Natarajan.
- Redwood reliability/ops: Rishi Malhotra (autoscaling + perf).
- ChiTel PM: Aisha Khan — dataset & access owner.
- ChiTel infra: Liam O'Shea — env/procurement liaison.

Open questions we flagged on the call
1) Will ChiTel provide a 5000-conversation sample (redacted) for week-1 baseline?
2) Any regulatory constraints on storing KV cache or logs beyond 30 days?
3) Target concurrency for agent assists (expected peak simultaneous agents)?

Immediate asks / next steps (please):
- Aisha: confirm dataset availability and whether procurement should be looped now or after scope is finalized.
- Liam: confirm whether trial should run in Redwood Hosted or Dedicated test pool (we recommend Hosted for faster iteration).
- ChiTel legal/procurement: we'll share a short SOW + trial T&Cs once scope is locked.

Attachments: chitel_poc_success_matrix.xlsx (success matrix), trial_test_prompts.jsonl (test prompts), redwood_trial_estimate.pdf (high-level cost estimate).

Thanks — I'll schedule a 30-min kickoff for next Tuesday unless you suggest otherwise.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0129
